theorem Roth.sqrt_lt_floor : ∀ {X : ℝ}, 2 ≤ X → √X < ↑⌊X⌋₊ ∧ ↑⌊X⌋₊ ≤ X :=
fun {X} hX ↦
  ⟨Roth.sqrt_lt_nat_floor_aux✝ hX,
    Nat.floor_le
      (le_of_lt
        (lt_of_lt_of_le
          (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
            (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))
          hX))⟩
